set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 8. Decide final artifact names, move archive-specific representation code into interop, move scientific transform execution out of archive core, move dataset archive and representation dispatch into interop or runtime, and update build edges and module documentation. Acceptance: archive core has no DCT, Haar, HRBF, transport, or BOLDZip reconstruction; latent core has no HDF5 or Zarr paths, object keys, byte codecs, or checksums; dataset core has no LNA, Zarr, or representation-family dispatch; the graph is acyclic; affected JVM and Scala.js gates pass.
set.title: RRA 8: extract interop modules and enforce dependency boundaries
